newsitem.title: USA: Antivirals Inc increases number of units.
newsitem.headline: Antivirals Inc increases number of units.

text.p: The number of units for the planned initial public offering in Antivirals Inc was raised to two million units from 1.5 units previously, lead underwriter Paulson Investment Co said on Tuesday.
A unit consists of one common share and one warrant.
The planned initial public offering, expected to trade on Wednesday, retained its estimated price range at $8 to $10 and proposed symbol for its units as "AVIIU" on the Nasdaq National Market.
Antivirals deals with biotechnology in the antisense field.
